scientific_integrity: Exact conditional hypergeometric proof; 72 independent exhaustive exact-rational tests and 2,896 monotonicity-grid cases support but do not substitute for proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to noninduced injective embeddings of motifs without isolates in G(n,m), h<=m<=binom(n-1,2). A potentially covering 1990 source was available only as an abstract; independent historical-priority review is outstanding.
title: Degree-one motif dependence and its leaf-number sign law in fixed-edge random graphs
